statement:
∀ (t : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (z : ℂ),
KdVPlan.J t f (KdVPlan.scale z g)=KdVPlan.scale z (KdVPlan.J t f g) ∧ KdVPlan.J t f 0=0
proof:
intro t f g z
constructor
· funext k
  rw [(yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 t f (KdVPlan.scale z g) k).2]
  by_cases hk : k=0
  · simp [hk,KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,KdVPlan.scale]
  rw [if_neg hk]
  change _ = z*KdVPlan.J t f g k
  rw [(yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_H002 h_T004 h_T005 h_T006 h_T013 t f g k).2,if_neg hk,← tsum_mul_left]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro j
  by_cases hj : k-j=0 <;> simp [KdVPlan.invD,KdVPlan.scale,hj] <;> ring
· funext k
  simp [KdVPlan.J,KdVPlan.S,KdVPlan.P,KdVPlan.mul,KdVPlan.invD]
